name: GhostCheckbox
description: Headless native checkbox. useGhostCheckbox owns boolean v-model and mixed state; GhostCheckbox is the thin unstyled input. Themed visual props live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled semantics: no activation, no sequential focus, and excluded from form submission.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled checked state. Omit it for uncontrolled use. undefined is uncontrolled; false is unchecked. Mixed is the indeterminate prop, not a third model value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial checked state when modelValue is omitted. Later changes are ignored.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Mixed state for select-all and similar. Applied through the DOM indeterminate property. Consumer-owned; not part of the v-model.

models.description: Checked state. Activation emits the native post-click boolean.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native checkbox after mount; null before mount and after unmount.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the native checkbox when it is mounted and enabled. No-op before mount.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the native checkbox when it is mounted. No-op before mount.

states.name: checked
states.description: Checked and not mixed. Omitted while unchecked.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: Mixed visual and AT state. Wins over checked when both apply.

keyboard.Space: Toggle checked when the control is enabled. Follows native mixed activation.
keyboard.Enter: Does not toggle. In a form, submits.
